news.title: Revolut Data Breach Exposes KYC and Bitcoin Transactions, Raising Competitive Risks
news.body: Revolut disclosed that a fake request from a government domain led to exposure of customer KYC and Bitcoin transaction data. High-net-worth clients are particularly affected, and the breach could prompt some customers to migrate to competitors like Monzo and N26, which have emphasized robust security practices. Regulatory scrutiny of Revolut’s data handling is likely to intensify, and rivals may target security-conscious users in their marketing.

news.title: AI Startup Cohere Eyes $20 Billion Valuation With Major Funding Round
news.body: Cohere is in advanced talks to raise $2–3 billion at a $20 billion valuation, signaling investor confidence in AI’s expanding role in financial services. The new capital could accelerate Cohere’s development of large language models for banks and fintechs, intensifying competition with OpenAI and Anthropic for enterprise AI contracts.

news.title: Unlimit Secures Hong Kong License to Expand Asia-Pacific Payments Reach
news.body: Unlimit obtained a money service operator license from Hong Kong’s Commissioner of Customs and Excise, deepening its Asia-Pacific footprint. This regulatory approval enables Unlimit to serve cross-border merchants and fintechs seeking access to Hong Kong’s financial hub, and positions it to compete with established players like Airwallex and Payoneer.

news.title: Visa Trust Index: 72% of US Consumers Now Use AI Assistants in Payments
news.body: Visa’s Trust Index reports that 72% of US consumers have used an AI assistant during payment journeys, highlighting rapid adoption of conversational AI for transactions and support. Banks and wallet providers are integrating AI-powered features to personalize user experiences and automate fraud detection, driving a new wave of digital engagement.

news.title: MoonPay Acquires Rhythm to Bolster On-Chain Trading Signal Capabilities
news.body: MoonPay acquired Rhythm, an on-chain trading signals platform, to enhance its crypto trading services. The acquisition allows MoonPay to offer advanced analytics and trading tools to crypto traders, intensifying competition with Coinbase and Binance for active market participants.

perspective: Revolut’s breach and Unlimit’s Hong Kong license show how security lapses and regulatory wins shape competition as AI and crypto tools reshape payments.
